body:
I want to start out by saying that I have tripped mushrooms 7-8 times before and have had a wide variety of different experiences.
I have been reading Terence McKenna, and excellent author and he is what inspired me to explore my own mind on this particular trip. The setting was my bedroom. I had a sheet covering up the side of my bed and a wall on the other side creating very thick darkness. I was alone and the plan was to meditate throughout the entire experience and show the Mushrooms as much respect as I could.
I was alone and the plan was to meditate throughout the entire experience and show the Mushrooms as much respect as I could.
Time Ingested: 9:30pm (t)
T+30: Laying in my dark room the small amount of light coming into my bed begins to slowly flash. It fades in and out for a while.
Colors are different and darker. The music becomes more powerful but somehow more distant.
T+35: I begin talking in a voice that is not my own. I speak with a jaded cynical tone. I cannot remember the words I spoke but they were not my own phrases or my own way of thinking. Possibly the voice of the mushroom?
T+45: My head feels light and the sheets feel very cool. I begin to hear my friends' voices laughing, talking to me about my own issues. Their voices are very accurate to them. I also envision girls in an extremely sexual and beautiful way. I realize that I am the problem. My issues stem from me but I can forgive myself. The mushrooms show me my true sexuality. My own internal use of language changes. I am thinking in images. The air seems filled with tiny patterns and color. A red light that seems to come from everywhere at the same time hovers over my eyes.
T+55: The visuals get more intense. Everything is warping and there is a double image laying over everything. I begin to feel intense euphoria. My soul feels at peace. I remember thinking that tripping the mushrooms was the best decision I could have ever made. And that I need to figure my life out and that I need to trip mushrooms again. I am laughing and so very very happy. I picture my friends laughing with me. I get up and go to the bathroom.
T+60: The walk to the bathroom is intense. Everything has 2-3 layers to it. Colors are ridiculously vivid. I barely contain myself
as my dad is sitting 20 feet away from me. I look in the mirror and look like the happy version of myself. Except different.
My face is wider my brows more pronounced. And my pupils are huge.
T+75 (roughly): Everything begins to fall apart. My ego is completely gone. I was is gone. Instead is replaced my body and the spirit of the mushrooms. I am thinking about the world in terms of pure language. Like my thoughts are equal to actions and space and time. My thoughts were dictating the future or so I thought. I walked carefully down the stairs and got into the bath with all my clothes on. It felt cold and wet. I looked at my toes and they looked demented and weird. I hear swooshing noises that have no source or location.
T+90 I get out of the bath and everything seems to go downhill. My euphoria is gone and it is replaced by a cold spirit. A rough sketch of where my soul used to be. I feel worried. My behavior is extremely erratic. I dance in contorted movements and suck on my fingers. I grab at my face to feel the bumps and lines in it.
T+120: I get back into bed with my wet clothes and I still feel rather cold and empty. The visuals are still there. Everything glows
from its core a emerald green color. I cannot discern between my thoughts and reality. They are one and the same. Life is the same thing as language. I get up and look in the mirror. My face is unrecognizable. I have massive empty eyes and my cheeks are gaunt. I stare insanely at myself and get upset because I think I have thrown my whole life away. I feel as though I will never come down, Or that when I do come down I will be a shell of myself. I feel like crying but I am too empty to cry. I turn on the light in my room and I hear a soft beautiful instrument playing. It sounds like a harp if the strings were brushed with a bow instead of plucked.
T+150: I am distraught I cant feel any part of myself. I feel my entire entity has been sucked into the spirit of the mushroom. I slowly begin to sober the slightest bit and it gives me hope. I remember that just like all my other trips I will come back down. I will be myself again once the ego death of the mushroom fades. I try to wave off the bad emotions and exhausted I get back into my bed and close my eyes.
